# --description--

A `TODO` usually sits next to a placeholder that keeps the code compiling until the real implementation is written. When you complete the work, replace the placeholder and remove the marker in the same change, so the comment never lies about the state of the code.

# --instructions--

Complete the work described by the `TODO` comment in `isEven`, then remove the comment since the work is done

# --before-seed--

```swift
// DO NOT EDIT FROM HERE
import Foundation

var _testCount = 0
var _testFailedCount = 0
func tryCatch(_ assertion: Bool) {
    _testCount += 1
    if !assertion {
        _testFailedCount += 1
        print("Test Case '--err-t\(_testCount)--' failed")
    }
}
// DO NOT EDIT UNTIL HERE
```

# --seed--

```swift
func isEven(_ n: Int) -> Bool {
    // TODO: return true when n is even, false otherwise
    return false
}
```

# --asserts--

The `TODO` comment must be removed

```json
{
  "regex": "TODO",
  "modifiers": ["m"],
  "shouldMatch": false
}
```

`isEven(4)` must return `true`

```swift
tryCatch(isEven(4) == true)
```

`isEven(7)` must return `false`

```swift
tryCatch(isEven(7) == false)
```

`isEven(0)` must return `true`

```swift
tryCatch(isEven(0) == true)
```

# --after-asserts--

```swift
print("Executed \(_testCount) tests, with \(_testFailedCount) failures")
```

# --solutions--

```swift
func isEven(_ n: Int) -> Bool {
    return n % 2 == 0
}
```
